source_text:
9.2 ζοσιμι ιν Περὶ τοῦ ὅτι
πάντα περὶ μιᾶς βαφῆς ἡ τέχνη λελάληκεν Ἀμέλει γοῦν καὶ Ἀφρικανός φησι· «τὰ
ὑπάγοντα εἰς τὴν βαφὴν μέταλλα καὶ ὑγρὰ καὶ γαῖ καὶ βοτάναι».
pass_a_gloss: 9.2 Zosimus in On that all things about one dyeing the art has-spoken. Accordingly then also Africanus says: 'the going-into the dyeing metals and liquids and earths and plants'.
pass_b_english: Zosimus, in On the fact that the art has spoken all things about one dyeing. Accordingly Africanus also says: “the things that go into the dyeing: metals and liquids and earths and plants.”

choices.term: μέταλλα καὶ ὑγρὰ καὶ γαῖ καὶ βοτάναι
choices.english: metals and liquids and earths and plants
choices.why: γαῖ is earths in this alchemical list, not 'gai' left unread or 'milk'.
rejected: metals and wet things and gai and herbs as food

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
